RPSC RAS Pre Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the notification for the post of Rajasthan State & Subordinate Service Exam 2026. This recruitment has been issued for 607 posts. Online applying process for RPSC RAS Pre Recruitment 2026 has started on 04 June 2026 & the candidates can apply till 03 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for RPSC RAS Pre Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 27 May 2026
  • Application Start Date : 04 June 2026
  • Last Date : 03 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 July 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 13 July 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 06 December 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 01-02 May 2027
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / Other State : Rs. 600/-
  • OBC / BC : Rs. 400/-
  • SC / ST : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 500/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
